target: forge.sh kind — any host label starting with gitlab (case-insensitive) is gitlab, in every URL form
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/o/r.git
k() { fx_setremote "$2"; fx_run kind; echo "$1=$FX_OUT"; }
k plain https://gitlab.example.test/o/r.git
k mixed https://GitLab-EE.corp.example.test/o/r.git
k scp git@gitlab.example.test:o/r.git
k sshport ssh://git@GITLAB.example.test:2222/o/r.git
k sublabel https://code.gitlab-eu.example.test/o/r.git
k dash https://gitlab-ee.example.test/o/r.git
fx_done
